references.text: The Lord shall judge between me and you - same expression where God is called to be the judge between two parties
The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor shall judge between us - invocation of God as judge in a conflict
David calls upon the Lord as judge between himself and Saul, like Jephthah who asks the Lord to judge between Israel and Ammon
The Lord shall judge between me and you - same wording as in Jephthah's message to the king of Ammon
The Lord will see it and avenge it - invocation of God's judgment in a conflict
Shall not all the judges of the earth do right? - God as the righteous judge over all
God is a righteous judge - affirms God's role as the one who judges fairly between the parties
Arise, you judge of the earth - invocation of God as judge over the nations
